senses.gloss: f. ch. (v. preced.) that which seems right, arbitrary will.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 9b:12">Sot. 9ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Judges 14:3">Jud. XIV, 3</cite> <he>ישרה בעיני</he>) <he>כי אזל מיהא בתר יַשְׁרוּתֵיה אזל</he> when he (Samson) went out (to marry), he, at all events, followed only his own liking (not the will of the Lord); [marginal version <he>יַשְׁרוּת עיניו</he>]; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 69">Yalk. Jud. 69</cite>.
